draft_key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: net revenue increased 11.3% to SEK 3,962.6M, EBIT declined to SEK 78.2M (2.0% margin) with a net loss of SEK 3M; operating cash flow rose to SEK 528M and net debt stood at SEK 292M.

Customer growth and market position: over 350,000 new customers acquired in Q4 alone; Norway surpassed SEK 1B in annual revenue; brand awareness reached 51% spontaneous top-of-mind among Swedish women (Q4 2025).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO's statement (page 7), Nordics & Europe section (page 21), Strategy brand awareness chart (page 16)

draft_key_information_units.information: Major logistics investment: new SEK 500M automated warehouse in Vansbro commissioned in 2025, increasing capacity to ~100,000 orders/day with full operation expected early 2026, enhancing flexibility and product availability.

Retail strategy expansion: first Fab Store launched in Täby Centrum (500 sqm) in November 2025 as a scalable blueprint; total stores increased to 34 (5 in Norway, 3 in Finland), including a mobile pop-up tour in Norway to scout locations.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Selected Events - Fab Store (page 47), Management Report store openings (page 62), Selected Events - Norway tour (page 50)

draft_key_information_units.information: Own brands acceleration: relaunch of Make Up Store with updated formulations and sustainable packaging; launch of Scandinavian Soap Factory and PLY Skin; own brands now a growing margin-contributing segment.
Segment divergence: Nordics segment grew 12.0% to SEK 3,699.8M (93.4% of group sales) while Europe declined 1.3% to SEK 130.7M; Europe reorganization initiated in December 2025 closing local offices.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Net Sales and Results per Segment table (page 63), Management Report (page 62)

draft_key_information_units.information: Liquidity and capital position: operating cash flow strengthened to SEK 528M; net debt reduced to SEK 292M; equity ratio decreased to 14.8% due to infrastructure investments.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures (page 6), Management Report financial position (page 62)

draft_key_information_units.information: Material post-reporting events: Kalmar Fab Store lease signed in January 2026 (opening spring 2026); SEK 100M annual cost savings program announced affecting ~70 FTEs; RCF extended to 2028 in March 2026; second Fab Store opened in Kalmar in April 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events after the end of the year (Management Report page 65)

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units cover headline financials (D1), customer/market metrics (D2), strategic infrastructure (D3), retail expansion (D4), margin-driving own brands (D5), geographic segment dynamics (D6), liquidity position (D7), and impactful post-year events (D8). All are material to understanding Lyko's 2025 performance, independently omittable, and directly supported by SOURCE without invented causality. Excluded routine governance, remuneration, risk lists, and accounting policies per evaluation guidelines.
